introduction: Figures come from COA Annual Audit Reports and appear only after sign-off.

topics.title: Government Totals
topics.summary: Revenue is income the government recognized. Expenses are its recognized costs, including non-cash ones.

metrics.label: Government Revenue
metrics.meaning: Total government revenue for the fiscal year.

metrics.label: Government Expenses
metrics.meaning: Total government expenses, including non-cash expenses and transfers.

metrics.label: Surplus or Deficit
metrics.meaning: Revenue less expenses. A negative amount is a deficit.

topics.title: Budget Execution
topics.summary: Appropriations authorize spending. Obligations are commitments made against that authority, not cash paid.

metrics.label: Current Appropriations
metrics.meaning: Spending authority for the current appropriations period.

metrics.label: Current Obligations
metrics.meaning: Commitments recorded against current appropriations.

topics.title: Revenue Sources
topics.summary: Where revenue came from. National transfers can move revenue without a change in local business activity.

metrics.label: Local Taxes
metrics.meaning: Tax revenue as reported.

metrics.label: National Tax Allotment Share
metrics.meaning: The government share of national tax collections.

metrics.label: Fees and Business Income
metrics.meaning: Income from services, fees and government business. Not private-business sales.

metrics.label: Other Revenue
metrics.meaning: Grants, other national shares and miscellaneous income.
metrics.formula: Revenue minus Local Taxes, National Tax Allotment Share and Fees and Business Income.

topics.title: Business Taxes and Fees
topics.summary: General Fund collections tied to business, permits, markets and property. Never added to the consolidated totals.

metrics.label: Business Tax
metrics.meaning: The Business Tax line in the General Fund.

metrics.label: Permit Fees
metrics.meaning: Permit fee revenue in the General Fund.

metrics.label: Market Operations
metrics.meaning: Receipts from government market operations.

metrics.label: Real Property Tax
metrics.meaning: Basic real property tax, net of the reported discount.
metrics.formula: Basic Real Property Tax minus its discount.

topics.title: Development Spending
topics.summary: Actual amounts under the Development Fund and Economic Services headings.

metrics.label: Development Fund
metrics.meaning: Actual amounts under the 20% Development Fund heading.
metrics.formula: Sum of reported actual amounts under the heading.

metrics.label: Economic Services
metrics.meaning: Actual amounts for offices such as agriculture, trade and tourism.
metrics.formula: Sum of reported actual amounts under the heading.

topics.title: Budget Utilization
topics.summary: The share of current appropriations recorded as obligations.

metrics.label: Budget Utilization
metrics.meaning: Obligations as a percentage of appropriations.

topics.title: Locally Generated Share
topics.summary: The share of revenue from local taxes plus fees and business income.

metrics.label: Locally Generated Share
metrics.meaning: Local taxes plus fees and business income, as a percentage of revenue.
metrics.formula: (Local Taxes + Fees and Business Income) / Revenue x 100.

topics.title: Development Utilization
topics.summary: Actual development amounts against the final budget for the same heading.

metrics.label: Development Fund Utilization
metrics.meaning: Development Fund actual as a percentage of its final budget.

metrics.label: Economic Services Utilization
metrics.meaning: Economic Services actual as a percentage of its final budget.

topics.title: Per Resident
topics.summary: Government amounts divided by the latest census population at or before the fiscal year.

metrics.label: Revenue per Resident
metrics.meaning: Government revenue divided by census population.

metrics.label: Expenses per Resident
metrics.meaning: Government expenses divided by census population.

topics.title: Business Trends
topics.summary: Annual registered business activity for one industry or Business Category. Shown only with simulated records.

metrics.label: Active Businesses
metrics.meaning: Businesses recorded as new or renewed for the year.
metrics.formula: Count of new and renewed business-year records.

metrics.label: New Registrations
metrics.meaning: Businesses newly registered in the year.

metrics.label: Closed Businesses
metrics.meaning: Businesses formally closed in the year.

metrics.label: Declared Sales
metrics.meaning: Declared gross sales of the group, after the privacy guard.

metrics.label: Share of Active Businesses
metrics.meaning: The group share of the town active businesses.

metrics.label: Share of Declared Sales
metrics.meaning: The industry share of town declared sales, where disclosure is permitted.

notes.title: Reading the Table
notes.text: Each row shows the selected fiscal year, the year before and the change between them. The Source line opens the COA report at the cited page. Change compares consecutive comparable years and does not rate performance. A missing figure says why.

notes.title: Coverage
notes.text: Fiscal years 2019 to 2025. Executive Summary totals cover all 29 towns for 2020 to 2024 and 13 towns for 2025. Breakdowns beyond totals are loaded for Tuguegarao City only. Full-year 2026 waits for a released report.

notes.title: Sum of Reporting Towns
notes.text: The sum of the city and municipal governments that reported, not the provincial government. Coverage states how many of the 29 towns reported, and change uses only towns reporting both years.

notes.title: What These Figures Are
notes.text: Government accounts. They are not private-business sales, GDP or a measure of economic growth. Sign-off checks the transcription, not the audit.
